{"id": "5fPvAEfxo6w", "snippet": {"title": "Why Did Silicon Valley Bank Collapse? $40 Billion Gone in One Day", "categoryId": "27", "description": "Silicon Valley Bank collapse explained from regulator records.
On 9 March 2023, customers withdrew more than $40 billion from Silicon Valley Bank in a single day; the next day it was closed. Using the Federal Reserve's 2023 review, its inspector general, the FDIC and a new 2026 independent review, we trace what went wrong, who saw it coming, and who paid.

Chapters
0:00 The run
1:09 The start-up bank
2:23 The bet on bonds
4:27 The warnings
5:51 Forty-eight hours
7:33 Who paid
9:30 Two verdicts
12:03 What the paperwork shows

Sources
[1] Federal Reserve Board, Review of the Federal Reserve's Supervision and Regulation of Silicon Valley Bank (28 Apr 2023): https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/files/svb-review-20230428.pdf
[2] Federal Reserve Board, Executive Summary of the review (28 Apr 2023): https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/2023-April-SVB-Executive-Summary.htm
[3] Federal Reserve Board press release on the review's results (28 Apr 2023): https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20230428a.htm
[4] Joint Statement by Treasury, Federal Reserve and FDIC (12 Mar 2023): https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20230312b.htm
[5] FDIC, First-Citizens Bank & Trust to assume all deposits and loans of Silicon Valley Bridge Bank (Mar 2023): https://www.fdic.gov/news/press-releases/2023/pr23023.html
[6] FDIC, Final Rule on Special Assessment Pursuant to Systemic Risk Determination (Nov 2023): https://www.fdic.gov/news/press-releases/2023/pr23092.html
[7] Federal Reserve OIG, Material Loss Review of Silicon Valley Bank, summary (25 Sep 2023): https://oig.federalreserve.gov/reports/board-material-loss-review-silicon-valley-bank-summary-sep2023.pdf
[8] Speech by Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman on initial findings from the independent review of SVB (18 Sep 2026): https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/speech/bowman20260918b.htm
[9] FDIC, Understanding Deposit Insurance: https://www.fdic.gov/resources/deposit-insurance/understanding-deposit-insurance
